Implement backend/src/main/java/com/kaapstyle/auth/controller/MfaController.java only.
- @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/auth/mfa') @CrossOrigin
- Autowire MfaService via constructor injection.
- Endpoints:
  * @PostMapping('/setup/{userId}'): calls mfaService.generateTotpSecret(userId), returns Map with secretKey and otpauthUri.
  * @PostMapping('/verify'): accepts Map with userId and 6-digit code, calls mfaService.verifyTotpCode(userId, code), returns 200 OK with {verified: true} or 400 Bad Request if invalid.
  * @PostMapping('/refresh'): accepts Map with userId and refreshToken, calls mfaService.rotateRefreshToken(userId, refreshToken), returns 200 OK with new {accessToken, refreshToken}.
